title: Live Preview
desc: The shader runs behind your code, so changes show up as you write.
detail: By default it recompiles shortly after you stop typing. You can also run shaders manually, in a separate activity or task, or only when you're not editing. The frame rate sits in the toolbar, and a quality setting trades resolution for speed. Very slow shaders are drawn a band at a time, so the phone stays responsive while you wait.
